description: Takes down one of the caller's own listings on XP -- 'take my listing down', 'I sold them elsewhere'. Buyers can no longer make an offer on it, every open offer on it is rejected, and those buyers are notified that it was removed. A listing with an accepted offer is an agreed sale and cannot be taken down here; XP support handles it. confirm=false returns a preview; confirm=true removes the listing, which cannot be undone. Relisting is a new create_listing. Requires sign-in.

confirm.description: False (default) previews. True takes the listing down.

listing_identifier.description: Listing identifier from list_my_listings or create_listing.

name: cancel_my_listing
title: Take Listing Down
